title: Gmail MCP Tool Planner
description: The Gmail MCP Tool Planner is a hybrid tool‑chain designed to automate Gmail tasks by first discovering available Gmail MCP (Mail Client Platform) tools and then ranking the most relevant ones for a user’s request. It uses a Node.js entry point that queries the @gongrzhe/server-gmail-autoauth-mcp server to list tools, and a local language model (LLM) to evaluate and rank those tools. The planner outputs the selected tool context and a generated prompt, which can be sent to a local Ollama instance via the OpenAI API format for further processing. The repository includes Python scripts for listing tools and interfacing with Ollama, along with environment‑variable overrides to switch between local and cloud LLMs. Google OAuth credentials are required for Gmail actions, and the setup intentionally separates planning from execution, allowing developers to extend the system with custom tool‑execution logic.
